name: snowflake-mcp
description: Read-only access to Snowflake databases with OAuth browser login. Query views, list schemas, and execute SQL with intelligent large-result handling.
long_description: A FastMCP server that provides secure, read-only access to Snowflake databases via OAuth browser authentication. Supports listing databases, views, describing schemas, querying data, and executing arbitrary read-only SQL. Large query results are automatically routed to CSV/JSON files when they exceed token limits.

tools.name: list_views
tools.description: List views in a database and schema

tools.name: describe_view
tools.description: Get column details and SQL definition of a view

tools.name: query_view
tools.description: Query data from a view with row limit

tools.name: execute_query
tools.description: Execute read-only SQL with smart output handling (auto-routes large results to CSV/JSON files)
